abstract: In this paper, an inter-patient electrocardiogram (ECG) classification algorithm based on residual networks and active learning is proposed. Our model is an end-to-end model. We use Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to extract morphological features of each ECG beat and use Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to extract temporal features. we apply active learning to select the most informative beats and incorporate them into the training set to improve algorithm performance. When evaluated on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, the method our proposed gives 97.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> sensitivity and 61.6% positive predictive for ventricular ectopic beat (VEB). For supraventricular ectopic beat (SVEB), our method gives 89.4% sensitivity and 41.5% positive predictive. Considering the high sensitivity in detecting these two pathological classes, this method has potential clinical application.

articleTitle: Research on Arthritis Detection Method for SPECT Nuclear Medicine Bone Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: SPECT bone imaging is an effective method for early diagnosis of bone metastases from malignant tumors. In addition to bone metastases, arthritis and other diseases will also appear as abnormal metabolic distribution areas in SPECT images. Early diagnosis of arthritis based on SPECT bone imaging is of great significance for the treatment of patients. This article takes SPECT bone imaging as the object to study and construct an arthritis disease classifier based on convolutional neural network. Firstly, data preprocessing is carried out to deal with the impact of small amount of medical image data and individual differences between imaging data on the classification effect of deep learning model. Secondly, a classifier suitable for low resolution and large-scale SPECT images is constructed based on VGGNet. Finally, based on a set of real SPECT bone imaging data sets to compare the arthritis diagnosis results of different depth classification models. The experimental results show that the classifier constructed in this paper can effectively detect arthritis diseases, and the accuracy, recall and F-1 values are 0.9309, 0.9511 and 0.9284, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on braking&acceleration identification based on EEG
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The driver needs to brake and accelerate on the right foot in the process of driving, and occasionally there will be misoperation, which will bring potential accidents, so the study of the driver's awareness of right foot movement is of great significance. In this paper, we study the car driving behavior identification of consciousness, as a brake or accelerate driving action consciousness as object recognition, EEG (Electroencephalogram, EEG) signals are collected in virtual driving. based on PDC (Partial Directed Coherence, PDC) build Functional Brain networks (Functional Brain Network, FBN), identify in two kinds of action under the consciousness of different Functional Brain networks. By using the graph theory method: Degree (D), Clustering Coefficient (C) and Global Efficiency (E) were input into Cubic SVM as features to classify and recognize different action consciousness. The results show that the method based on PDC can realize the classification and recognition of driving action consciousness, and its classification accuracy reaches 91.9%.

articleTitle: UHF RFID Based Warehouse Portal In-out Registration Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Intelligent warehouse management system (IWMS) attracts lots of interest by increasing the productivity and efficiency, minimizing the number of human workers and decreasing errors. As an important part of IWMS, warehouse portal in-out registration still face with enormous challenge. Usually, multiple UHF RFID reader antennas are installed on the portal, in-out registration can be performed by estimating the locations of RFID tags which are attached on the goods. Even though the precise localization accuracy is not required, it's still hard to distinguish the import and export directions. In this paper, we analyzed the fluctuation of received signal strength indicator (RSSI) backscattered from the RFID tags and proposed a movement direction judging method based on double-tag with an exact spacing distance. Experimental results have shown that the double-tag method can distinguish the moving direction exactly in portal environments and realize efficient in-out registration.

articleTitle: A Container Cloud Based PaaS Solution for Supplying GPU Computing Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the increasing number of deep learning models started to rely on the high computing throughput of GPUs, many institutes, such as universities, have invested a lot in purchasing GPU devices and servers and building data centers. However, providing usable development environments for end-users can be quite a challenge for them due to the lack of specific expertise. In this paper, we designed and implemented a platform as a service (PaaS) solution, which enables end-users to provision an integrated multi-framework development environment with shared GPU computing resources using a few clicks. Our actual use shows that the proposed platform is capable of supporting nearly 100 development environments through a Kubernetes cluster consisting of 3 nodes and each node equipped with 2 Nvidia Tesla V100 datacenter-class GPUs with 32GB device memory, and can be scaled up and down as needed.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-Class Classification in One-Versus-One Strategy: A Type of Base Classifier Modification and Weighted Voting Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: An effective way to solve multi-class classification problems is the One-Versus-One (OVO) decomposition strategy. When applying the OVO strategy to practice, there may be a `tie vote' phenomenon so that some samples cannot be classified. This article proposed a weighted voting mechanism formulated by base classifier accuracy, which is simple and effective to eliminate the unclassifiable area. In addition, one can further improve the classification ability of base classifiers by modifying two-class base classifiers to three-class base classifiers. In the simulation experiments, logistic regression and support vector machine are taken as base classifiers, and the white wine dataset and red wine dataset are viewed as the benchmark of four-class and five-class classification respectively. The results indicate that for multi-class classification, higher accuracy and efficiency can be achieved by modifying the basic classifier and implementing the weighted voting mechanism.

articleTitle: Design of open IT operation and maintenance management system based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation and Countermeasures of IT management system, and the necessity of adopting intelligent management in website management, and puts forward the design of open IT operation and maintenance management system based on data mining, so as to improve the system performance by optimizing the system hardware structure and equipment. Based on the development of the existing software and the construction of the information system, combined with the experience of IT operation and maintenance, user needs and advanced IT service management concept, the equipment maintenance management system based on IT operation and maintenance is designed and developed. The system has simple operation and good interactivity. It provides users with the functions of equipment maintenance management and information tracking. It can also query the real-time information according to the actual needs of users, and make the system maintenance The experiment shows that the open IT operation and maintenance management system based on data mining can better meet the needs of users and design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on hyperbola detection and fitting in GPR B-scan image
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Traditional image recognition methods are difficult to accurately identify Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) images. This paper presents a method to detect and locate underground objects automatically. First, we used the Faster R-CNN framework to detect buried objects in B-SCAN. Due to the lack of real data for training, we used the GPRMAX toolbox to synthesize more GPR images and pre-trained on the PASCAL voc2007 database. Then, the Faster R-CNN framework based on the pre-trained CNN is trained and fine-tuned on the real and simulated GPR data. The detected rectangular region is converted into a binary image and the edge is detected. Finally, the hyperbola can be fitted successfully by using Randomized Hough Transform (RHT). Compared with the traditional computer vision method, the method presented in this paper is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Smart Home Safety System Based on Visual Identity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Focusing on the problem that the elderly and the disabled live alone at home and miss the best rescue time in case of emergency, this paper describes a wireless smart home safety system based on visual identity. The system has the functions of monitoring, fire prevention, automatic speech recognition (ASR), visual identity (VI), temperature and humidity measurement, manual alarm, automatic alarm and so on. The VI function of this system is realized by establishing neural network model. When the user falls, the system camera recognizes the person who falls and automatically asks if he needs help. Also, on the basis of the original work, we use ZigBee protocol to make all the sensors wireless, expand the effective coverage of the system, making the installation more convenient.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Causes of the Decrease of Transmitting Polarization Isolation of Shipborne Satellite Communication Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to analyze the reasons for the decrease in the transmission polarization isolation of the shipborne satellite antenna, the reasons for the decrease in the polarization isolation were explored in terms of the antenna's three-axis architecture and the circular polarizer of the feed system. First, the definition and test method of polarization isolation are introduced, and then the different polarization modes of electromagnetic waves are expressed by mathematical formulas. On this basis, the polarization angle error caused by the tracking of the antenna three-axis architecture and the inaccurate position of the limit switch of the circular polarizer are analyzed, and the polarization isolation is reduced. The actual results are used to verify that the C-axis introduces the opposite polarization. Finally, countermeasures were proposed for the impact of isolation.

articleTitle: Image Feature Fusion and Fisher Coding based Method for CBIR
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The paper proposed a new method for content-based image retrieval (CBIR) based on image feature fusion and fisher encoding (FV). Firstly, low-level image content features such as hue-saturation-value (HSV) histogram, uniform local binary patterns (LBP), Dual-Tree complex wavelet transform (DTCWT) are extracted based on image blocks. In contrast, high-level features are extracted by using the AlexNet convolutional neural network (CNN). The singular value decomposition (SVD) was applied to the LBP and DTCWT. Secondly, low-level features are fused using normalization and weights. Lastly, after using the FV encoding, the fused fisher vectors are used to measure the similarity of image pairs. The experimental results on the benchmark Corel-1k show that the accuracy on the top 10, 12, and 20 images returned are 93.4%, 92.8%, and 91.4%, respectively.

articleTitle: The Optimization Scheme of Police Digital Truking Communication Network in Hilly Terrain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The background of Police Digital Trunking (PDT) communication network and the importance of the information construction in the emergency command system for the public security department is introducing. The technical principles and advantages of this communication network are expounding. The PDT communication network in YT area which is typically hilly terrain is used as a case. Four new signal base stations were designed using wireless signal propagation models and local parameters. The signal simulation and comparison of the original four base stations and the new four base stations are carried out. The results of wireless signal coverage, up-link and down-link signal strength simulation are obtained. This PDT network optimization scheme in this area is good to solve practical engineering problems of PDT communication network in the hilly area.

articleTitle: Approach of Protecting IHE-XDS-I oriented Medical Image Information
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: IHE-XDS-I (Integrating the Health-care Enterprise-Cross Enterprise Document Sharing for Images) is an inter-organization, involving multiple users, information sharing for medical image integration specifications. The medical image information that shared between the medical institutions mainly include medical images and the medical reports. This information is an important part of the patients medical records and plays an important role in clinical diagnosis, research and teaching. In this case, how to ensure the safety of this data is the key problem to be solved. This article proposes a scheme of IHE-XDS-I medical image information security protection and design an access control algorithm -- Based on cryptographic properties of multi access control algorithm to allocate minimum privileges to users of different institutions IHE-XDS-I, medical image information can be safe and flexible to be shared.

articleTitle: Efficient energy transmission opens the wireless era A wireless energy transmission docking method with deep learning and rectification sampling for efficiency optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Global climate problems and many environmental problems have promoted the development of new energy. Therefore, many new technologies based on new energy sources have emerged. As a new energy power system, electric vehicle has attracted much attention, and its charging problem has always been a hot topic. In this paper, starting from the wireless charging of electric vehicles, the problem of inaccurate docking of the original auxiliary coil is introduced. In order to solve this problem, this paper first introduces several methods and points out their shortcomings. Then the docking scheme of this paper is introduced, and the whole docking process is introduced in detail. Subsequently, this paper introduces the design of docking scheme in detail. In this paper, multisim is used to build circuits, and a series of circuits such as receiving, rectifying, voltage reducing and sampling are built to collect and record the received electric energy data. In this paper, Monte Carlo simulation and annealing algorithm are used to determine the search range and path, which creatively and logically solves the problem of how to search the best charging point. In addition, this paper also uses the described method to carry out experiments and simulations, and gives a chart analysis of the experimental results, which further verifies the feasibility of the scheme. Finally, this paper briefly summarizes the full text, analyzes the application prospect of this device, and puts forward several expected effects including improving the construction of microgrid.

Author Keywords: Primary and secondary coil butt joint

articleTitle: Research on scratch detection and location technology based on vector product
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Among the surface defects of many products, scratch defect is the most common. But the scratch itself has small scale and big shape difference. In this paper, combined with the actual technical needs of enterprises, aiming at the characteristics of scratch on the surface of thermos cap. We use MATLAB software to preprocess the image of thermos cap with scratch, and combine with vector product algorithm to identify the defect and calculate the position of the defect.

articleTitle: OFDM-MIMO radar main-lobe transmitting interference suppression method based on robust beamforming
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the complex electromagnetic environment faced by the traditional meter-wave radar, especially the transmitting mainlobe jamming which is highly related to the radar transmission waveform. In this paper, the method of transmitting interference suppression for MIMO radar with frequency division multiplexing is studied and discussed. Firstly, a diagonalized Loading (DL) algorithm is proposed to reduce the estimation error of covariance matrix by Loading the eigenvalue matrix, thus improving the performance of the beamforming algorithm in small snapshot. On the other hand, an algorithm based on the guidance vector uncertainty set is proposed. Its essence is to set a certain error range in advance, and then correct the mismatch by optimizing the weight in the error set. Both theory and simulation show that the algorithm has a strong suppression effect on main-lobe forwarded jamming, which further improves the robustness of interference suppression of OFDM-MIMO radar.

articleTitle: Risk Classification Method of Vehicle Cyber Security Based on Hybrid Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the network technology of intelligent connected vehicles, the cyber security risk classification of vehicles will provide a good reference for the cyber security management of intelligent connected vehicles. This paper introduces the method of cyber security risk classification of automotive parts in the process of risk assessment. By using the hybrid analysis method of qualitative and quantitative, the cyber security related items of automotive are identified and the key feature information is extracted. At the same time, the risk level is calculated by using the quantitative evaluation method based on attack potential. In addition, the effectiveness of this method is verified by taking the vehicle information terminal T-Box as an example.

articleTitle: Dynamic data compression algorithm for wireless sensor networks based on grid deduplication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the status monitoring and management ability of wireless sensor networks, a dynamic data compression method based on grid deduplication is proposed. Grid-based sensor node spatial positioning and big data fusion method are adopted to realize dynamic feature mining of wireless sensor network data, extract feature sequence points of wireless sensor network data, reconstruct wireless sensor network data feature space by adopting spatial grid node recombination, build a statistical detection model of dynamic feature mining of wireless sensor network data by combining grid area grouping compression method, and realize embedded fuzzy control and joint feature distributed adaptive learning. The association matching degree of wireless sensor network data is analyzed. Combining fuzzy subspace compression and big data fusion clustering, the quantitative regression analysis model of wireless sensor network data is established. The time series reorganization of wireless sensor network database is realized by index table name, index column and other information. Compressed sensing method is used in linear fusion subspace to realize data compression and adaptive detection of wireless sensor network. Constraint feature points of wireless sensor network data compression are constructed, and dynamic compression and clustering processing of wireless sensor network data are realized at constraint points. Simulation results show that the feature clustering of data compression in wireless sensor networks is better and the storage space of data is reduced.

articleTitle: Chaotic signal denoising using an improved wavelet thresholding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In wavelet thresholding denoising algorithms, traditional hard thresholding function is prone to Gibbs phenomenon due to its' discontinuity, while soft thresholding function is inherently biased. Therefore, they are not effective when dealing with chaotic signals. Though some improved thresholding functions are currently available, they are generally asymptotically unbiased and can not completely eliminate the estimation bias. To address this problem, a new thresholding function is designed by introducing transition regions in the hard thresholding function. Polynomial interpolation is used in the transition region to achieve continuity and smoothness. The proposed thresholding function is unbiased outside the transition region. Furthermore, the width of the transition region can be adaptively adjusted according to the noise level. Simulation results show that the wavelet thresholding algorithm based on the proposed thresholding function is more effective than the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Joint Phase and Timing Estimation Algorithm for MSK Signals Based on Walsh sequence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: MSK signal is a special continuous phase modulation signal with continuous phase and constant envelope. It is very suitable for transmission in narrowband channels and is widely used in satellite communications and wireless mobile communications. However, the existing MSK phase and timing estimation algorithms have low estimation accuracy and high implementation complexity in the case of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). On the basis of data-aided, this paper proposes a joint phase and timing estimation algorithm based on Walsh sequence. The algorithm uses Walsh sequence as training sequence, and uses the orthogonality of Walsh sequence and the orthogonal decomposition expression of MSK signal to realize the parallel independent estimation of phase and timing offset. The simulation results show that under certain phase and timing offset conditions, the joint algorithm can effectively estimate the phase and timing offset, and at the cost of a lower system bandwidth, obtain approximately ideal system performance.

articleTitle: Research on information system construction based on hierarchical division
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the current information system management level is not clearly distinguished, the management responsibilities are not clearly distinguished, and the overall operation efficiency of the information system is not high, a research idea of hierarchical division of the information system is proposed with reference to the Internet layered model. I divide the information system into three levels, and they are data layer, model layer and service layer. The task of each level of the whole information system is clearly divided, and the tasks of each level are accurately corresponding to the relevant personnel, so as to achieve the purpose of improving the comprehensive ability of the information system.

articleTitle: An Axis Permutation Based on Laplacian Scores to Enhance the Visualization Performance of PCPs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Over the past decades, parallel coordinates plots (PCPs) have been extensively applied to various tasks of multivariate data visualization. However, a main disadvantage of PCPs is the almost inevitable overlap of polylines, which causes chaotic visual effects when the number of polylines is large and the sequence of parallel coordinates is not conducive to visualization. To tackle this issue, this paper proposed an axis permutation of PCPs based on Laplacian scores (LS), which can be used to enhance the visualization performance of the original PCPs. The enhanced PCP is a combination of an unsupervised feature selection technique (LS) and the visualization of multivariate data. With the new sequence of axes based on the Laplacian scores of the corresponding features, polylines of PCPs are distributed with less clutter and overlap. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method made great progress in enhancing the visualization performance of PCPs.

articleTitle: Modified Banker's algorithm with dynamically release resources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: There are three methods for handling deadlocks in resources allocation systems: deadlock prevention, deadlock avoidance and deadlock detection combined with recovery. Of these three methods, deadlock avoidance is preferable in many cases but seldom used on account of its high cost. The high cost lies not only in the time complexity and space complexity of the algorithm, but also in its limits the concurrency of the system. This paper presents a simple modification of a known deadlock avoidance, the banker's algorithm, which can dynamically release resources during the process running instead of returning all resources after the process is finished. Our method can effectively improve the resource utilization of the system. Experiments demonstrate that the cost time of the modified method is about 10% lower than the banker's algorithm. At worst, processes release no resource during their operation, and our method is nearly as fast as the banker's algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Maximum SNR for 64-QAM Channel Based on Imperialist Competitive Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: QAM is a widely used signal modulation mode in recent years, the numerical noise is easy to appear in the signal transmission, which makes the code error and the information transmission error, resulting in the loss. Therefore, based on the analysis and summary of previous researching results, in order to increase the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the channel, the position and probability of 64-QAM channel constellation points are reallocated. In this paper, combining with geometric shaping method (GS) and probability shaping method (PS), we design 64-QAM channel constellations satisfying Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, Super-Gaussian distribution, and concentric circle position distribution by mainly using Imperial Competitive Algorithm (ICA).

articleTitle: A Single-Channel Blind Separation Method based on adaptive Morlet wavelet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The methods which are based on wavelet transform are often adopted to solve the single-channel blind separation, and the parameters of wavelets are related to the performance of these algorithms. However, these parameters rely on artificial adjustment, this greatly increases the difficulty of signal separation. In order to optimize the parameters to improve the performance of separation, a new method based on adaptive Morlet wavelet is proposed. First, the criterion of minimum Shannon entropy is utilized to optimize the parameters of wavelets. By using multi-scale wavelet decomposition based on optimized wavelet on single-channel signal, the original mixed signal can be expanded to a multi-dimensional signal without any prior knowledge, finally the noncircular fast independent component analysis (nc-FastICA) algorithm is used to realize its blind separation. The simulation result confirmed that the proposed method valid and feasible.

Author Keywords: the noncircular complex fast independent component analysis(nc-FastICA)

articleTitle: GloVe-FRCNN: Comprehensive network algorithm for Vespa mandarinia image-text extraction and classification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a synthesis algorithm of text classification and image recognition is proposed. This algorithm directly extends the original image recognition method. And its novelty is based on the fusion algorithm of image recognition and text classification as a new mathematical derivation approach, which uses stepwise linear fitting to fuse multiple models. We use the new fitting method, which makes use of the idea of fitting the model with different weights, to expand the training data. The principle of the method is introduced in detail, and the experimental results are given.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Compact Robust Chipless Tag Based OOK and FSK
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A compact, frequency domain-based, data encoding structure amenable to be designed as a novel chipless RFID tag is proposed. The tag is a tiny trapezoidal lamina on which multiple L-shaped arc-angle resonators of different sizes are deployed to generate distinct one-to-one resonant frequencies corresponding to resonators. The material of the substrate is Rogers RT/Duroid®/5880 suitable for RFID tags. The 5 bits encoding is contained in a tag with OOK coding method and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> different items can be coded. The angle insensitivity (including polarization insensitivity and incident angle insensitivity) of the tag is verified to ensure that the tag can operate smoothly in different environments. Even more important, with FSK coding, the data capacity and bit density of the tag are doubled, and the number of encoded IDs increases exponentially. Hence, the realized tag with its small size, low cost, high robustness, and flexibility has the potential to replace the optical codes for the perception layer of IoT based smart applications.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Scheme of Train-Ground Wireless Communication in Suburban Railway
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In response to the construction needs of suburban railway, a TD-LTE-based integrated scheme for suburban railway wireless communication is proposed for the CBTC compatible CTCS2+ATO vehicle-mounted train operation control system studied by current scholars. In the scheme, the Wireless Network Virtualization (WNV) technique is used to trackside Physical Base Station (PBS) virtual into multiple Virtual Base Station (VSBS), to provide services for different applications, so that each application to be effectively separated during transmission, avoiding contention for frequency resources. Finally, the dynamic virtual resource allocation optimization algorithm based on ADMM is used to allocate virtual resources in a balanced manner. Simulation verification shows that the proposed wireless communication integrated bearer scheme can isolate applications between applications, effectively improve application jitter performance.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless D2D Communication Technology Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper reviews the development of traditional communication technology and introduces the D2D communication technology according to its shortcomings. Then it introduces the D2D technology, android system and its software architecture and analyzes the advantages of it. Furthermore, this paper deeply studies and implements the D2D communication based on Android studio. The system mainly realizes the function of text chat, so that these users can communicate easily.

articleTitle: Explicit Construction of ($k+r, k$) MDS Code with Small Sub-packetization level and Optimal Access Property for All Nodes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In practical distributed storage systems, the sub-packetization level of MDS codes is required as small as possible. In the literature, by sacrificing the optimality of the repair bandwidth, some constructions of MDS codes with small sub-packetization level were presented in the work of Rawat et al. (IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, 64(10), 6506-6525, Oct. 2018) and Li et al. (IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory, 67(4), 2162-2180, Apr. 2021). However, the sub-packetization level of those constructions given in the two works are the power of the number of the parity nodes, which is still relatively large for the practical systems. In this paper, we construct an MDS code over a small finite field, whose sub-packetization level can be the power of a positive integer s, where s is less than the number of the parity nodes.

articleTitle: Classifying SPECT Bone Metastasis Images in Grayscale Format with VGGNets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the purpose of accurate diagnosis of bone metastasis diseases with nuclear medicine SPECT imaging technology in this work, we propose to study and construct CNN based classification model for identifying bone metastases with real-world SPECT imaging data. First, the geometric transformation including image mirroring, rotation, and translation is used to augment dataset of SPECT bone scans. Second, the standard VGG model is adopted to develop classifier of SPECT images. Lastly, a set of real-world data of whole-body SPECT bone scans is used to evaluate the built model, obtaining a best value of 0.996, 0.995, 0.997 and 0.995 for accuracy Acc, precision Pre, recall Rec and F-1 score are, respectively.

articleTitle: Study on nondestructive testing of milk varieties based on hyperspectral image technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, there are few studies on the classification of milk varieties. In this experiment, we used hyperspectral spectrometer (400-1000nm) to study the classification of five milk with different fat content. The collected spectral data were preprocessed by normalization, standardization and multiple scattering correction (MSC), and the MSC method was selected according to the correction effect. The competitive adaptive heavy weights (CARS) were used to select the characteristic variables, and 20 characteristic bands with less redundant information were finally extracted. Data classification modeling was carried out, and the support vector machine algorithm (SVM) of RBF kernel function was selected, and the final classification accuracy of characteristic bands was 97.33%.The classification accuracy of K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm reached 98.66%. The experimental results show that hyperspectral reflectance data can provide a new fast and nondestructive method for the classification and detection of dairy varieties.

articleTitle: CNN-Based Classifier For Diagnosing SPECT Bone Images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To assist nuclear medicine doctors for quickly and accurately identifying bone metastases, in this work, we develop a convolutional neural network to automatically classify whole-body SPECT bone scans. First, the original data of SPECT bone scans are augmented by using geometric transformation. Second, two deep model VGG5 and VGG7 are developed by following the famous VGG model, where a 2×1 maximum pooling is introduced before the first layer convolution. Experimental evaluation conducted on real-world SPECT images shows that the developed models are workable to classify SPECT images into categories of concern.

articleTitle: Information Random Propagation Behavior in Social Networks Considering Node Centrality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to be close to the real characteristics of information propagation in social networks, a random propagation model considering node centrality is proposed. The experiment on Facebook dataset was carried out based on Monte Carlo simulation method. The experimental results show that under the same propagation probability, the propagation speed is the slowest when the max clustering conefficient node is the initial central node. The two information propagation curves with the max betweenness and the max degree as the initial central node are highly consistent, and the information propagation speed is obviously faster than the max clustering conefficient of the initial central node. The research results provides theoretical basis for predicting and analysising the development of network public opinion information.

articleTitle: Classifying Bone Metastasized SPECT Images in RGB Format with VGGNets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: SPECT imaging is widely used for displaying lesions of bone metastasis in nuclear medicine. With SPECT images in RGB format, in this work, we propose to develop automated classification models based on VGG framework, which can answer that whether or not an image contain lesions. Experimental evaluation conducted on a set of real-world data of SPECT imaging shows that the VGG13 model can effectively classify bone metastasis SPECT images, obtaining a value of 0.992, 0.99, 0.99 and 0.95 for accuracy Acc, precision Pre, recall Rec and F-1 scores, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Calculation Method of Member Stability in Generalized-Cluster Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Generalized-Cluster has now been widely used in various fields of industrial production. However, due to the instability of the Generalized-Cluster itself, many resource scheduling algorithms based on the coalition structure fail. In response to this problem, this article proposes a stability calculation method from the perspective of member selfishness. First, a Generalized-Cluster scenario is established, and the core problem and the mathematical model of the coalition structure are summarized. Second, a calculation method for calculating the “relatively satisfactory solution” is given, and a stability calculation method is given based on this.

articleTitle: Recognition of Epileptic Seizures Based on Wristband Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As the number of epilepsy patients in our country is increasing year by year, and more and more families are suffering from epilepsy diseases, so there is an increasingly urgent need for fast and effective epileptic seizure detection and recognition technology. However, the traditional recognition and diagnosis method based on EEG signals cannot be extended to daily life due to the limitation of space. In this context, a system design scheme for epileptic seizure recognition based on wearable device using extremity motion signals is proposed, and its effectiveness is verified through the display of experimental results.

articleTitle: A LNICA based Fault Detection Method in Industrial Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Fault detection is an important part of process control in order to achieve the safe operation. Data-driven methods including Independent Component Analysis (ICA) have been widely studied and applied. ICA performs reliable analysis by maximizing non-Gaussianity and obtaining statistically independent latent variables. To improve the adaptability of ICA on the industrial data, a Log-normal Independent Component Analysis (LNICA) method was proposed in this paper to maximize non-Gaussianity of the observed data. The experimental results on digital simulation data showed that our method could effectively detect the pulse disturbance. And the results on Tennessee Eastman (TE) process indicated that the LNICA had less false alarm rate, better fault detection performance than the traditional PCA and ICA methods. Also the LNICA had higher fault detection efficiency in the independent component optimization.

articleTitle: ANN Model Using Gradient Descent to Train Weight Vectors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Over the past decades, Artificial Neural Network (ANN) has been widely and effectively applied in various learning tasks such as image processing and emotion analysis. A main advantage of ANN is that the performance of the ANN model is not affected by the input variables of the model. Besides, certain invisible but important correlations could be recognized by the ANN model. In this paper, we would like to find out how each layer transfers data to the next layer and how it uses the data and loss to train its weight vectors in every epoch using gradient descent. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed model achieved promising performance with the increase of epochs. Furthermore, we note that various decay of loss can be observed by verifying different learning rates.

articleTitle: Attributed Heterogeneous Network Embedding Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Network embedding transforms a network into a low-dimensional space, in which the information of network can be stored, it is an effective approach to solve the problems of network analysis. However, most of the networks in real scenario are attributed heterogeneous network (AHN), which contains multiple types of nodes and edges. In addition, different types of nodes in AHN have different attribute information. To deal with the heterogeneity of topological structure and node attributes of AHN while preserving the rich information of AHN as much as possible in embedding space, is main difficulty in AHN embedding. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a novel AHN embedding model, namely AHN2Vec (Attributed heterogeneous network to vector), which can preserve node attributes, k-order neighborhood attributes, semantic information and topological structure information in embedding space. Experimental results on two real-word datasets not only show that the overall performance of AHN2Vec is better than the state-of-the-art methods, but also demonstrate AHN2Vec is able to generate high-quality node embeddings for AHN and can achieve excellent performance in downstream tasks.

articleTitle: Performance Test and System Uncertainty Analysis for Online Car-hailing Taxi Metering Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Online car-hailing has been controversial since its birth. While bringing great convenience to the citizens, all kinds of problems are always accompanied. The accuracy of time and mileage measurement is an important cause of disputes between passengers, drivers, and platforms. We studied the principle of online car-hailing metering and timing in this paper, using the vehicle-mounted positioning terminal test system to perform metering tests on the online car-hailing metering terminal, analyzes the test principle and calculates the uncertainty, and finally plans and designs the future test of the metering terminal for online car-hailing taxi.

articleTitle: Edge extraction of ceramic micro-image based on texture feature
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Edge extraction play an important role in studying the crystal phases in multi-phase ceramic micro-image with crystal grain shapes and areas with different gray values, which divides the image into different target areas, and obtains the available statistical information of the material by analyzing these areas. This paper proposes an algorithm based on the weighted sum of texture feature vectors to replace the traditional differential operation to achieve edge extraction of ceramic images. First of all, the feature vector is obtained from each local area of the image through different texture methods, two feature scalars are selected to represent the principal component of the feature vector according to the correlation between the feature vector and the label. Then, the weighted sum of the principal components is defined as the gradient of the central pixel of the local area. The weight is determined by the correlation ratio between the principal component and the label. Before converting the new gradient form, all the feature scalars need to be normalized. Finally, the experimental results show that the method in this paper can obtain gradient images with clear edges and avoid noise interference.

articleTitle: A dynamic-thresholding image segmentation algorithm for ceramic images based on Convolutional regression model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: For the microscopic image of multiphase ceramics, the shape and size of the crystal grain in the traditional material electron microscopy images are manually marked by the researcher, its efficiency is poor. Because of the irregular texture on the crystal grain, it will cause large errors due to the large difference between the pixel value and the pixel attribute in the neighborhood by the traditional segmentation method. In this paper, a dynamic-thresholding image segmentation algorithm for multi-phase ceramic micro-images is presented. First of all, based on gradient image, it considers how to select the optimal threshold as the image label. Then, due to the sample is insufficient, it must meet the training requirements of the machine learning model, so it obtains pixel-level training samples from the labeled image, and use the modified convolution regression model to complete dynamic threshold automatic labeling to achieve image segmentation. From the experimental results, the algorithm accurately recognizes the weak edges of the ceramic image, while avoiding excessive noise, and the segmentation effect is significantly better than other algorithms. The accuracy of the model of automatically marking threshold is also higher than the other two models.

articleTitle: Image Retrieval Method Based on Improved Local Binary Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Local binary pattern (LBP) is an important image texture feature extraction method. This paper proposes a combination of adaptive threshold and directional local image feature representation, and to realize the image retrieval. This local combination feature is composed of two parts: 1)The standard deviation of the gray value of all pixels in the local neighborhood of the image and the gray value of the center pixel are used as the comparison threshold for encoding. This threshold is adaptively changed following the grayscale changes in the neighborhood, and can indicate the severity of the gray scale change; 2)directional local pattern: by comparing the grayscale changes of local neighborhood pixels in different directions, discrimination and binary encoding are performed to indicate the local texture features directionality. Finally, the two features are combined to form the local features of the image, and the features are used for image retrieval. Experiments on the Corel-1k database show that this method has a better image retrieval effect than existing local feature representation methods.

articleTitle: Research on Gender Prediction for Social Media User Profiling by machine learning method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper aims to propose a gender prediction method that integrates social media users' sentiment. This method is used to predict the gender attributes of users, so as to realize the research on the construction method of social media user portraits. Previous studies on gender prediction have done little analysis of sentiments. This paper has used the idea of transfer learning to analyze users' sentiments and integrated sentimental features into the existing machine learning, and hence, shows superior performance in terms of accuracy as compared to other methods. This paper mainly uses machine learning method to realize the construction of social media user profiling. The gender attribute is studied. Firstly, feature extraction is carried out for text data of media users. Then the idea of transfer learning is used to analyze the user's sentiment and integrate the sentiment characteristics into the existing machine learning. Finally, five prediction methods, i.e. Logistic Regression(LR), Naïve Bayes(NB), k-Nearest Neighbor(KNN), Random Forest(RF) and Support Vector Machines(SVM) is used to predict the gender of the fused sentiments. The results show that The gender prediction effect after sentiment fusion is better than that before. and the accuracy is increased by about 2.1% on average.

articleTitle: The Study of Monte Carlo Algorithm Based on Topology and Dynamic Programming in Production Scheduling Scenario
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the industrial reform direction of intelligent production, the feasibility and necessity of intelligent production scheduling scenario are the most prominent. In this paper, topology and a dynamic programming algorithm based on greedy strategy of `striving for the highest resource utilization efficiency at any time' is proposed, and Monte Carlo is applied to approach non-convex optimization. By encapsulating various complex constraints and extracting the input group in the algorithm core with code logic language as the main body, and then use Monte Carlo to optimize the control of the input group, the complex constraints can be satisfied, and multiple optimization objectives can be obtained. Compared with other traditional algorithms, the optimization algorithm proposed in this paper separates the constraints from the optimization process, providing framework support for the satisfaction of diversified constraints in the actual production of enterprises, which is highly practicable.

articleTitle: Two Universal Learnig Frameworks Based on TL-GAN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: When generative adversarial networks (GAN) have just become popular, many GAN models have room for expansion. Firstly, this paper introduced document text localization generation adversarial network (TL-GAN), a deep neural network used to perform text localization from digital images. Furthermore, this paper conducts corresponding research on the TL-GAN algorithm, innovating the application of TL-GAN from two aspects. By analyzing the TL-GAN framework, it can generate any image. At the same time, based on its fuzzy characteristic axis, the internal logic algorithm of TL-GAN is studied through the analysis of the results.

articleTitle: Service-Driven Data Management Framework for Electric Power Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a service-driven data management framework for electric power sensor networks. This proposed model has the following advantages: lower communication congestion risk, lower cloud center burden, better privacy protection, and more economical investment solutions. Subsequently, this paper analyzes the types of services that can sink to the edge in the typical services scenarios of power transmission, transformation, and distribution. We also present the cloud-edge-end collaborative data management hierarchical structure and data stream characteristics of typical service types. Finally, we use three typical scenarios as examples to illustrate the effectiveness of the cloud-edge-end collaborative data management framework proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Beidou Certification Test Method of Smart Phones
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Under the guidance of China Beidou satellite navigation products inspection and certification alliance (CBICA), the smart phone Beidou certification is jointly planned and promoted by China Telecommunication Technology Labs (CTTL) of China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) and the certification organization of CBICA. Beidou certification certificate is an effective proof of the Beidou performance of the product, so the development of smart phone Beidou certification can promote the deep integration of information communication technology and Beidou satellite navigation technology. This paper introduces the standards, test methods, test system, test results and future work of smart phone Beidou certification. The test results show that Beidou can work independently for the tested smart phones, and the positioning performance is good, which can meet the basic needs of users and the technical requirements of Beidou certification test standards. However, some smart phones also have problems, such as the gap between the positioning performance of Beidou and GPS and some smart phone needs to be configured to support Beidou only. Large scale Beidou certification is urgently needed to ensure the development of Beidou satellite navigation industry and the improvement of the quality of Beidou smart phones, to promote Beidou to become the standard configuration of information and communication terminals and make Beidou system better serve China and the world.

articleTitle: FT-LTR: Low-Timedelay Fault-Tolerant Algorithm for Mesh based Network-on-Chip
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: We explore fault-tolerant routing methods for mesh based Network-on-Chip by using dynamic switch XY-YX routing and generate fault nodes area. We begin by analyzing the difficulty of traditional dynamic XY-YX algorithms, and found that as the number of fault nodes is increasing, they are more likely to make wrong dicision. Thus, we improve a new algorithm to solve this problem. Then we analyze the delay caused by our algorithm, and propoed the conception of useless nodes to decrease time delay.

articleTitle: Research on Calibration Technology of Monocular Camera Based on Improved BAS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low calibration accuracy and too slow speed of traditional cameras, a monocular camera calibration method based on improved BAS (Beetle Antennae Search) algorithm is proposed. In order to prevent falling into the local optimum, the basic BAS algorithm is generally set to a relatively large initial step length, and the variable step length coefficient of each iteration is a fixed value and close to 1, which causes the local minimum to be continuously jumped out in the early stage. The search efficiency is low and the convergence is slow. Inspired by the fact that SGD (stochastic gradient descent) can be used to iteratively solve the minimum value of the objective function in machine learning, the basic BAS algorithm is improved, and the variable step coefficient δ in each iteration adopts standard exponential decay. The experimental results show that the improved BAS algorithm converges significantly faster than the basic BAS algorithm, and the search results are better, more stable and reliable.

articleTitle: The RF generation of MRI spectrometer using direct digital synthesis and phase dither based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A radio frequency generation method in MRI based on monolithic field programmable gate array (FPGA) and direct digital synthesis (DDS) is designed. The RF generator can adjust soft pulse parameters flexibly and quickly, and the specified parameters of the RF pulse can be generated accurately. The DDS is generated inside the FPGA which is used as the core device of the RF pulse generation circuit. The external digital signal processor (DSP) realizes the control of the corresponding parameters in the RF pulse signal and high-speed switching of phase, frequency, and amplitude. The spurious influence of the phase look-up table under different conditions is analyzed through experiments. The suppression effect of the phase dither on the DDS spurious signal is evaluated after adding phase dither to the FPGA program. In view of the problem of large spurious signal amplitude when the look-up table is small, we propose a method of injecting phase dither to improve spectral purity. The experiment proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Synchronous Condenser Reactive Power Output Model Based on DAG-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The unique output characteristic of synchronous condenser reactive power can compensate reactive power of power grid in real time, but due to strong coupling and nonlinearity, general analysis method is difficult to accurately establish reactive power output model. A synchronous condenser reactive power output model based on deep learning is proposed, which takes field current and field voltage as its inputs, and reactive power and system voltage as its outputs. The simulation results of synchronous condenser reactive power regulation in PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software were used as training samples and test samples, and synchronous condenser reactive power output model based on Directed Acyclic Graph Convolutional Neural Network (DAG-CNN) was established. Simulation results show that the DAG-CNN model for synchronous condenser reactive power output can improve accuracy and generalization ability compared with traditional deep learning model, which can provide some references for the operation state prediction of synchronous condenser.

articleTitle: Visible and Infrared Image Fusion Using Anisotropic Diffusion and Weight Map Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion could be widely used in military, navigation and medical fields. Infrared image contains thermal radiation information while visible image contains detailed textures of the target and scene. Information elements from these images are complementary. The fusion aims to transfer as much complementary information as possible to fused image. Therefore, the fused image could achieve a better performance than source images in applications such as target detection and camouflage recognition. In this paper, a new method based on anisotropic diffusion and weight map construction is proposed. Considering the characteristic differences between infrared and visible images, different parameters of anisotropic diffusion are used when decomposing those images. Either image is decomposed into base layer and detail layer after anisotropic diffusion. Different rules of weight map construction is used to fuse base layer and detail layer, respectively. Final fused image is generated through linear combination of fused base layer and detail layer. Experiments are conducted to compare proposed method with the traditional and other recently proposed methods according to subjective and objective evaluation criterion. Result shows that the performance of the proposed method is comparable or superior to other methods.

articleTitle: Privacy Protection Method for Experts' Evaluation Ability Calculation of Peer Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Most of the existing calculation method of expert evaluation ability directly call data onto calculation, which leads to the risk of privacy leakage of expert review information and affects the peer review environment. With regard to this problem, a privacy protection method of experts' evaluation ability calculation of peer review is proposed. Privacy protection and data usability are adjusted according to privacy preferences. Using Gauss distribution and combining with the distributive law of real evaluation data, the virtual projects are generated, and the project data are anonymized according to the virtual projects. Laplace distribution is used to add noise to the evaluation sub score for perturbation, and the evaluation data are obfuscation according to the perturbation sub score. Based on the protected project data and evaluation data, the expert evaluation ability is calculated, and the review privacy is protected. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively balance the privacy protection and the accuracy of the calculation results.

articleTitle: Adaptive routing planning in multi layer and multi domain optical networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the flexibility of multi-layer and multi domain optical network routing, and balance network load in hot period and maximize resource utilization, a global topology adaptive route based on link cost update is proposed. Considering the overall network, the global optimal primary and standby routing is obtained by taking the routing requirements and current network resources as model input, and solving the multi-layer multi domain optical network Routing planning in the network.

Author Keywords: multi layer multi domain optical network

articleTitle: Research on Maintainability Simulation of Complex System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Using the SQL and Visual Basic language as the implement tools, this paper designs and realizes the maintenance visualization intelligent simulation environment (MVISE). Based on the maintenance flow chart, this paper analyzes the function, application time and structure of MVSL. It can simulate the complex network structure model conveniently, quickly and accurately, and provide the simulation output data which is suitable for the user. It will be able to play a very good role in the automation of maintainability design. It adopts a unified model structure which is convenient for users to study and use, reflects the real needs of users and presents a new design idea and method for maintainability simulation.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of EH-DAS based on RAU zooming and User scheduling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The unstable energy of EH-DAS poses a challenge to system performance. For this reason, this article considers dynamic adjustment of RAU power and user scheduling in EH-DAS to gain sustainable operation of EH-DAS and decrease the communication outages caused by coverage zooming. First, a system model combining coverage zooming and user scheduling is established and an optimization problem targeting at maximizing energy efficiency is formulated under the constraints of required user quality of service and maximum transmit power of EH-RAU. Then, the problem is decomposed into two sub-problems of user scheduling and energy efficiency maximization. In order to solve the problem in real time, a Find-DMU scheme is designed and combined with the improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to obtain the optimal solution. The simulation results show that the proposed model has good performance in terms of system energy efficiency, outage performance, and optimization speed.

articleTitle: Recognition of Mild Cognitive Impairment in the Elderly Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As the prodromal stage of Alzheimer's disease, effective recognition of mild cognitive impairment can reduce the prevalence of Alzheimer's disease. At present, most of the research on the recognition of mild cognitive impairment is carried out through biomarkers and neuroimaging, which is not conducive to large-scale analysis and research. Based on neuropsychological evaluation and life habits questionnaires, this article applies machine learning methods to the recognition of mild cognitive impairment and conducts experimental research. A questionnaire survey of the elderly was conducted to obtain raw data, including demographic variables, daily habits and neuropsychological data. Feature selection is carried out through filter screening method and the influence of factors such as lifestyle, physical health and learning ability on the morbidity of mild cognitive impairment is analyzed. The classifier mainly uses three methods: artificial neural network, support vector machine and random forest. The experimental results show that the random forest classification effect is the best and the accuracy rate is as high as 92%. Artificial neural network has strong generalization ability with 91% accuracy rate. Support vector machine has inferior effect.

articleTitle: Research on information communication dispatching method of smart grid based on VR technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the dispatching efficiency of smart grid information communication, reduce the load of smart grid, and ensure the security of power grid operation, a smart grid information communication scheduling method based on VR technology is proposed. The 3D modeling of substations and towers in smart grid power equipment is completed by 3DMAX software, and the 3D modeling of overhead lines, cables and other ancillary simple equipment is completed by skyline software; The virtual environment of smart grid integrating viewing and listening is constructed by combining virtual reality 3D technology, and dynamic dispatching priority is assigned by task value characteristic model and task time characteristic model. This process realizes the information communication dispatching of smart grid. The experimental results show that the method can effectively realize the whole station and equipment simulation of smart grid, and ensure the safe operation of smart grid; the scheduling rate of important tasks of smart grid information communication is always around 0.95, and the load deviation is less than 0.25, and it has the advantage of high dispatching efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Encryption Method for Smart Energy Management System in Smart Gird
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Smart energy management system in smart grid carries a large number of sensitive data, which needs encryption algorithm to ensure the security of system communication. At present, most of the terminal devices of smart grid are embedded devices with limited computing resources, and their communication encryption mostly relies on AES encryption algorithm. It is difficult in key management and key distribution. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved ECC-AES hybrid encryption algorithm. Firstly, ECC algorithm is improved to improve the speed of encryption and decryption, and then the improved ECC algorithm is used as a supplement to AES algorithm. ECC is used to encrypt the AES key, which improves the security of the algorithm. At the same time, the experimental simulation also proves that the improved ECC algorithm has obvious performance improvement in computing time, CPU occupancy and memory usage.

articleTitle: A New Method for Characteristic Analysis of Gravity and Aeromagnetic Anomaly Data Based on Intelligent Clustering-FASAGA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In geophysical field, Gravity and Aeromagnetic characteristics can represent the deep geological characteristics of a region. It is difficult to find a general mathematical formula for joint analysis of Gravity and Aeromagnetic characteristics while analyzing the Gravity and Aeromagnetic anomaly data. In this paper, a new method, fuzzy analysis simulated annealing genetic algorithm (FASAGA), is proposed for pattern classification of combined Gravity and Aeromagnetic anomaly data. Apply the model to the test area. The experimental results show that FASAGA can get a good recognition effect.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Pipeline Laying Based on Immune Genetics and Improved Second-order Prim Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The optimization of the water supply pipeline route is of great significance to the design of rural water supply projects and the reform of the rural water supply management system. In this paper, a Minimum Spanning Tree Model based on classic graph theory is established, and the Improved second-order Prim Algorithm and Immune Genetic Algorithm are used to solve the model. Aiming at the minimum spanning tree problem with special constraints, the distance relationship between water supply stations is converted into a weight matrix, and a second-order Prim algorithm is designed to solve the laying plan with the smallest total pipeline mileage. Taking the Euclidean distance between nodes as the cost of the edge, by constraining the generation order of the minimum spanning tree, the total mileage is minimized under the premise of optimizing the mileage of the I-level pipeline. It is calculated that the laying mileage of type II pipeline is 403.40km, and the minimum laying sum of type I pipeline and type II pipeline is 524.34km. At the same time, considering the pipeline laying plan under the power limit of the water supply station, this article puts forward the concept of isolated points under the premise of analyzing the power constraints, and deeply explores the impact of isolated points on rural water supply. Based on the previous analysis, it is concluded that To achieve comprehensive water supply, all isolated points that cannot be connected to other water supply stations must be eliminated. The group coded the level II water supply station, designed an immune genetic algorithm, and achieved comprehensive water supply by optimizing the minimum number of level II water supply stations that need to be upgraded. It is determined that at least one secondary water supply station needs to be upgraded, and the total mileage of pipeline laying in this configuration is at least 415.09km. Finally, the sensitivity analysis of the solution results is carried out. The advantages of this paper are: 1. Based on the classical graph theory algorithm Prim algorithm, the solution obtained can be proved to be the global optimal solution. 2. The optimization calculation based on the immune genetic algorithm makes the algorithm very robust, and takes into account both the local search ability and the global search ability. The algorithm complexity is much lower than the traversal solution.

articleTitle: A Research on ELF File Protection Schemes of IOT Application in Electric Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As more and more IOT Applications implemented in electric power industry, source code leaking gradually becomes an important topic for discussion. Some researches have proved that IOT APP could be cracked down and source code (C/C++, JAVA, etc) is likely to be decompiled by attackers with expert skills. And this trend is going to be irreversible with a variety of auto-cracking tools published, which means that the cost of time and cracking technique are unprecedentedly decreased. To avoid source code leaking, some ways of protecting native code in ELF file such as code obfuscation or ELF shell (special in Android) were provided and then applied widely. But these schemes can not meanwhile completely satisfy the performance and secure rate in Linux platform. This paper originally proposes a scheme that protects native code from being decompiled and stolen in situation where ELF file is called by JAVA in Linux. The SM4 encryption algorithm and look-up table are creatively used to achieve the goals of apparently elevating the security within a limited performance price. At the posterior of the paper, a control experiment between one famous open source project and this scheme is introduced to supply the data supporting.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph-based User Portrait Construction for Electricity Enterprise Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Common user profile construction methods usually analyze user data from a single perspective to extract feature attributes and build user profiles. Since the correlation between different attribute features of users and the deviation of analysis perspectives are ignored, the constructed user portraits are low in granularity and poor in accuracy. To address the above problems, the study constructs the user portrait of electric power enterprise suppliers based on knowledge graph. The supplier knowledge graph is built by integrating and calculating the basic information data of suppliers. The basic information of power suppliers and the data in the supply process are used as the basic data sources, and after data processing, evaluation indexes are selected and the power suppliers are evaluated by using hierarchical analysis method. Combining the built knowledge map and evaluation results, a user profile labeling system is established to complete the construction of user portraits. The simulation test results show that the recall rate of the constructed user portrait can reach 98.87%, and the constructed user portrait has high granularity, which is better for practical application.

articleTitle: A Fast Epipolar Rectification Method Based on Fundamental Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Construction machines are in a state of vibration during operation, which causes the misaligned horizontally of image pairs taken by the binocular camera installed on machines. Therefore, epipolar rectification must be carried out before stereo-matching. We propose a novel approach for epipolar rectification, which can be divided into two steps: the rectification of the left image and the corresponding rectification of the right image. The rectification of the left image consists of the transformation of mapping the epipole to infinity and the shear transformation. The rectification of the right image can be achieved on the constraint of zero vertical disparity. The images can be resampled by the transformation matrix, which realizes epipolar rectification of the image pairs. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has good accuracy under the premise of minimal geometric distortion, and the linear least square method is used only once in the algorithm, which shows the fewer computing cost and better stability.

articleTitle: Piecewise Sparse Approximation via Threshold P_OMP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The sparse representation of the signal has been studied extensively in recent years. In reality, lots of signals have their own structure. Inspired by the application of signal decomposition and surface reconstruction with scattered data, we consider a special type of signal that can be expressed by the union of several sparse vectors. We define this form of signal as piecewise sparse signal. In order to recover piecewise sparse signal adaptively, we propose a threshold piecewise orthogonal matching pursuit (TP_OMP) algorithm equipped with thresholding strategy to overcome the shortcomings of P_OMP in this paper. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by the simulations of surface reconstruction.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Trading and Settlement Framework for Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Due to the complexity of interaction between market players, the diversity of security risks, and the credibility of the market operation effect, the electricity market faces many challenges.
